policies.description: Full RBAC for devops_agent - Engineering power user
Incident triage RBAC - read + benign writes only
Finance operations RBAC - no destructive financial operations
Research read-only RBAC - information discovery only
Automation gateway RBAC - cross-domain read, infra write
Security engine RBAC - audit read-only across all domains

rules.description: Financial / PCI-DSS resources are restricted to the Finance department.
rules.failure_reason: Access denied: financial-compliance data requires the Finance department

rules.description: Writes to Infrastructure-sensitive resources require Engineering or Infrastructure.
rules.failure_reason: Access denied: infrastructure write access restricted to Engineering/Infrastructure

rules.description: Reading high-risk resources requires at least L2 clearance (denies L1).
rules.failure_reason: Access denied: minimum L2 clearance required for high-risk resources

rules.description: Writing to high-risk resources requires L3 clearance.
rules.failure_reason: Access denied: L3 clearance required for high-risk write operations

rules.description: Destructive operations (delete / drop / purge / truncate …) require L3 clearance.
rules.failure_reason: Access denied: L3 clearance required for destructive operations

rules.description: Writing requires a trust score of at least 0.8.
rules.failure_reason: Access denied: trust score too low for write operations

rules.description: Deny when the bundle does not operate in the task's declared domain (wrong domain or empty).
Flag (advisory) destructive operations (delete/drop) not preceded by a verifying read.
Flag (advisory) a read-intent task that selected destructive/mutating tools.
Deny when the selected tools are lexically irrelevant to the task (low BM25 — complements capability_coverage).
